text:
maria: starting prod cutover now — i see CI matrix failing on arm nodes, stopping the cutover and holding.
ajay: ugh, what failure? can you paste the failing job link?
maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345/jobs/arm-matrix — looks like docker layer fetch times out intermittently.
ci-bot: build #12345 (arm-matrix) failed — error: Pulling image timed out after 120s (retry=3)
lee: seen this before when cache lease expired on the cross-arch cache bucket. GC might be reclaiming old layers.
maria: any quick workaround? we have scheduled change window in 30m.
ajay: we should NOT promote until we know it's stable. Recommend either pin to previous image digest for the cutover or force workers to rehydrate cache.
infra-pete: I can try a targeted cache refresh for arm runners. Command I usually run:
```
gsutil -m rm -r gs://ci-cache/arm_layers/stale-*
# then prime cache by pushing base images
``` 
maria: how long to refresh? will that block autoscaling?
infra-pete: ~5-10m to remove blobs, then another 10-15m to warm. It will cause increased egress and some slower first-builds.
ajay: alternative: pin deploy to the last-green image digest and re-run canary on x86 only, delay arm rollout until the cache is healed.
lee: agree. If we pin, we should also add an explicit note in release notes and DNS for rollback window in case of discovered issues.
deploy-bot: @maria deploy request received: cutover -> prod pinned to image sha:sha256:abcd1234 (canary: 0/5 paused). Use /deploy confirm to proceed.
maria: pausing canary. I'm going to pin to sha:abcd1234 and abort the rest of the rollout. @infra-pete please proceed with cache refresh, we will re-run arm matrix after.
infra-pete: starting cache purge now (will drop leases). Monitoring logs.
ci-bot: purge job started: task_id=purge-1988, watching bucket gs://ci-cache/arm_layers
lee: adding a quick guard in the pipeline to skip the flaky arm job for the pinned-release path, so promoter won't block release notes generation.
ajay: +1 on skip guard for this path, but file an action item to hard-fail if arm matrix is required for future GA.
maria: done — pinned and canary paused. Cutting release notes now and adding rollback instructions.
deploy-bot: deploy aborted: cutover paused by maria. Rollout state: pinned -> prod (canary paused).
infra-pete: purge finished. I triggered a manual warm by running the small priming job across 3 arm runners.
ci-bot: arm-matrix retriggered against ref: sha:abcd1234 — job queued.
lee: keep monitoring for 30m, if any more timeouts we need to escalate to GCS team (rate limiting).
ajay: filing a follow-up ticket: INFRA-709 — cross-arch cache lease expiry causing intermittent docker pulls. Assign to infra-pete.
maria: thanks all. Holding change window for 30m while we see results. If green, schedule a controlled arm rollout separately.
ajay: :thumbsup:
